links.outcome: Subgroup discrimination parity (FNR, TNR) across ethnicity, education, income, deprivation
links.effect: Prediction parity was not reached in FNR and TNR by ethnicity, education level, household income and Townsend deprivation score; parity was achieved for immigration status.
links.quote: Prediction parity was not reached in FNR and TNR in terms of ethnicity, education level, average household income before taxation, and Townsend deprivation score.

links.outcome: Calibration of predicted versus observed risk in an external validation cohort
links.effect: All three models systematically overpredicted risk in the UK Biobank validation cohorts, with the degree of overprediction varying between models.
links.quote: Overall, all models showed systematic overprediction of risks for the UK Biobank validation cohorts, with the degree of overprediction varying between the models.

screen.reason: Evaluates algorithmic fairness, calibration, and demographic parity of existing, widely deployed clinical risk prediction models (QRISK3, QDiabetes, QStroke) on UK Biobank data, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
